reapack.name: AI Music Lab
reapack.desc: Unified AI Music Lab plugin: Audio2Midi, MidiGenerator, Text2Audio, StemsSeparator, Setup

metadata.description:
Single REAPER window with a tab per tool, replacing the 4 previous standalone plugins plus the standalone Setup wizard:
· Audio2Midi — audio to MIDI transcription (Basic Pitch, YourMT3+) · MidiGenerator — MIDI generation from text, or accompaniment for a melody (Amadeus, Anticipatory, MIDI-GPT) · Text2Audio — text to audio generation and audio editing (ACE-Step, Stable Audio Open, MusicGen, AudioGen) · Stems Separator — stem separation with Demucs (local) and SAM Audio (cloud or local) · Setup — global environment configuration (uv, Modal, per-tool prewarm)
Native gfx UI: no external REAPER extension dependencies.
Requirements: Python 3.11+, uv, Modal account (free tier sufficient for most models)

version.author: AI Music Lab
version.changelog: Fixes: · Setup: "Install deps" now repairs a broken environment by itself. If `uv sync` fails (corrupt .venv, vanished interpreter, bad uv cache) it deletes shared/.venv and retries with --reinstall --refresh, then checks that `modal --version` really runs before reporting success. · Setup: the Modal CLI check now shows why it failed instead of "modal not available". · Failure reports include every attempt's output (reaperai_setup_report.txt).

version.author: AI Music Lab
version.changelog: Fixes: · Setup: "Install deps" no longer fails without detail. setup_helpers.py and Audio2Midi/transcribe.py crashed at import under Python < 3.10 (PEP 604 annotations); they now run on any Python 3. · Setup: if the helper dies before reporting progress, the panel now shows the last log line instead of a bare "Error" (also for uv, login and demucs). · Setup: when an install fails, a full diagnostic report (command, exit code, Python/uv versions, PATH, complete output) is saved to reaperai_setup_report.txt and can be opened from the panel to debug it or paste to an assistant. · ReaPack: Audio2Midi/research/uv.lock is now published (install returned 404).

version.author: AI Music Lab
version.changelog: New in this release: · MidiGenerator: accompany a melody with Anticipatory (no seed track needed) and MIDI-GPT; arrangement controls (parts, density, creativity). Retired text2midi, MuseCoco, MIDI-LLM and ChatMusician from the UI. · Audio2Midi: local Basic Pitch for single instruments (adjustable note threshold, ghost-note cleanup, input level normalisation); MIROS removed. · Local/remote execution toggle for Anticipatory, SAO, SAO-edit, MusicGen, AudioGen and SAM Audio (models that cannot run locally keep it disabled with the reason). · Text2Audio trimmed to the models that proved useful: Generate = ACE-Step, Stable Audio Open, MusicGen, AudioGen; Edit = SAO style transfer, ACE-Step. · MIDI is imported track by track without InsertMedia, so existing clips and tracks are no longer wrapped or moved. · StemsSeparator: SAM Audio OOM fix (larger default GPU, bounded chunking, errors shown in the panel). Fresh random seed per Amadeus generation.

version.author: AI Music Lab
version.changelog: New in this release: · Renamed Text2Audio to "AudioGenerator" in the UI (technical paths unchanged). · Model dropdowns across all tabs now order models by real-world popularity. · Unified Model/Source layout across tabs; StemsSeparator's DEMUCS/SAM AUDIO sub-tabs merged into a single Model dropdown; fixed widget clipping and readonly-field overflow bugs introduced by that layout change. · Per-model example-prompt pickers added across all generation panels. · Generated tracks/folders (StemsSeparator, Audio2Midi, MidiGenerator, AudioGenerator) now land right below their source track/clip instead of always at the end of the project. · Each panel's action button now doubles as a Stop button while a run is in progress. · New global window collapse-to-header toggle, persisted across sessions. · Tabs reordered (Text2Audio, Stems Separator, Audio2Midi, MidiGenerator); Setup moved out of the tab bar into its own button. · Subprocess failures now surface the real underlying error instead of a bare exit code, across Setup/Text2Audio/Audio2Midi. · Fixed symmetric left/right content margins inside every tab's scroll area. · Fixed crashes in Foundation-1 (never-downloaded weights), Mustango (missing setuptools/pkg_resources), AudioGen and MAGNeT (invalid model.to("cuda") call) generation; InspireMusic 1.5 now honors the requested duration instead of always generating its fixed default.

version.author: AI Music Lab
version.changelog: Fix installer: MidiGenerator/smf_writer.lua was missing from the package sources, so panel.lua's dofile() of it failed with "No such file or directory" right after a fresh install.

version.author: AI Music Lab
version.changelog: Consolidate Audio2Midi, MidiGenerator, Text2Audio and StemsSeparator (plus the standalone Setup wizard) into a single tabbed plugin. The 4 previous packages are now deprecated stubs that open this plugin on the matching tab.
